youtube_title: Angry When You're Hungry? Hangry Is Real | Body Fix #42 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #42. 2 PM, no food yet, and you're snapping at EVERYONE? Hangry?
B is right. Low fuel, and your body releases STRESS hormones. Hangry is real.
Skipped breakfast + late lunch = short temper, zero focus.
Fix: Eat breakfast, carry nuts or fruit, protein + fibre meals, no long gaps.
Red flags: Shaky, sweaty, confused, very thirsty, peeing a lot? See a DOCTOR.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: Healthline / research - hunger and mood
